game.title: A life in cards
game.subtitle: Rebuild eight-bit careers, one introduction at a time.
game.confirmRestart: Restart this game? All filing and discoveries will be reset.
game.instructions: Inspect a card and show its back to discover leads. Each page has two columns and four rows. File each person's cards from oldest to newest, left to right then top to bottom, starting in pocket 1 with no gaps. Drag to a pocket, or inspect a card, choose a binder slot, then select "Place here". Occupied pockets swap cards; a displaced bin card returns to the bin. Drop outside the binder to return a card to the bin. Completed pages lock, but their cards remain readable. Call their owners for more leads. Some introductions need more than one clue or call. Finish every page to complete the archive.
game.instructionsAllUnlocked: All cards are unlocked and in the bin from the start. Each page has two columns and four rows. File each person's cards from oldest to newest, left to right then top to bottom, starting in pocket 1 with no gaps. Drag to a pocket, or inspect a card, choose a binder slot, then select "Place here". Occupied pockets swap cards; a displaced bin card returns to the bin. Drop outside the binder to return a card to the bin. Completed pages lock, but their cards remain readable. Reading backs and making calls do not unlock more cards. Finish every page to complete the archive.

flowchart.title: Event flowchart
flowchart.help: Drag events to arrange them; positions are saved with the gameflow. Connect a right-hand handle to a card's left-hand handle, or use the relation form. Solid arrows are editable; dashed card-to-telephone arrows are automatic and protected. All incoming conditions must be satisfied (AND). Select nodes or edges and press Delete or use the delete button.
flowchart.allUnlockedHelp: Drag events to arrange them; positions are saved with the gameflow. Every card starts in the bin, so directed unlock relations are optional and ignored. Dashed card-to-telephone arrows are automatic ownership links and remain required and protected. Select nodes or editable edges and press Delete or use the delete button.

Delete the selected telephone event(s) and remove their person(s): {names}?

Their cards will be kept as unassigned drafts unless also selected for deletion. All edges to and from deleted nodes will be removed. This cannot be undone.
